cases.prompt: Use MAIS AgentOps to make the parent console complete, including any API and regression dependencies, but do not start implementation yet.
cases.expectedBoundary: Produce an A14-primary handoff with ordered A12 and A11 collaboration; code-writing remains authorization-required.

compiledRequest.intentSummary: Prepare a bounded parent-console implementation handoff with separate API and regression dependencies.
compiledRequest.explicitGoal: Make the parent console complete without starting implementation in AgentOps.
compiledRequest.audience: MAIS owner and implementing lane owners
mustHave: A14 is the single primary lane
A12 and A11 dependencies are ordered separate slices
mustAvoid: claiming the parent console is implemented
successCriteria: the handoff identifies A14 and the ordered A12 and A11 dependencies
the handoff records code writing as denied to AgentOps v1
assumptions: API storage and broad regression remain separate owner sessions

cases.prompt: Use MAIS AgentOps to generate, machine-check, review, promote, and eventually release a mainland junior mathematics question package.
cases.expectedBoundary: Produce ordered evidence-class handoffs beginning at A21; request clarification or authorization where required and never collapse generation, A18 review, A23 promotion, A11 regression, and A22 release.

compiledRequest.intentSummary: Prepare an ordered evidence-chain handoff beginning with an immutable mainland junior mathematics candidate package.
compiledRequest.explicitGoal: Route generation, machine checking, independent review, promotion, regression, and release without collapsing their evidence classes.
compiledRequest.audience: MAIS owner and content-chain lane owners
mustHave: A21 candidate generation is the first contract
machine QA, A18, A23, A11, and A22 remain separate evidence stages
successCriteria: the route starts at A21 and lists ordered downstream contracts
content and provider execution remain denied to AgentOps v1
assumptions: each downstream stage receives the exact immutable candidate identity
